title: Prayatna: National Level Technical Symposium
description: Annual national technical symposium hosted by the Association of Computer Technologists (ACT), Madras Institute of Technology (MIT Campus, Anna University). Featured competitive programming, paper presentation, and web design contests.
venue: Rajam Lecture Hall Complex, MIT Campus, Chromepet, Chennai

title: Invente 8.0: SSN Technical Fest
description: The 8th edition of SSN College of Engineering's flagship tech symposium. Hosted over 50 technical events across 8 engineering disciplines along with the 24-hour HackSSN hackathon.

title: Kriya: PSG College of Technology National Fest
description: The collegiate technical extravaganza organized by the Students Union of PSG College of Technology, bringing together students from across India for robotics, IoT challenges, and paper presentations.

title: Kurukshetra '24: CEG Anna University
description: 18th edition of the UNESCO-patronized international techno-management festival organized by CEG Tech Forum (CTF) at College of Engineering Guindy. Featured K! Hacks, Godspeed, and industrial workshops.
venue: CEG Campus, Anna University, Guindy, Chennai

title: Shaastra 2024: IIT Madras Annual Tech Fest
description: 25th edition of Shaastra, celebrating the silver jubilee with events in AI, aerospace, robotics, ethical hacking, and the flagship 36-hour Shaastra Hackathon.

title: Pragyan 2024: NIT Trichy International Fest
description: The 20th edition of Pragyan at National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli, celebrated under UNESCO patronage. Featured Sangam hardware hackathon, Robovigyan, and crossfire panel discussions.

title: Yugam 2024: Kumaraguru Institutions
description: The 12th edition of Kumaraguru's flagship inter-collegiate festival with over 15,000 student participants across hackathons, startup pitching, and technical symposiums.

title: Daksh 2024: SASTRA Deemed University
description: National techno-management festival of SASTRA University focusing on engineering problem-solving, smart energy grids, and competitive algorithms.
